walk_mass_rederivation.verdict: The only mass that moved stayed far above the 1% floor, so no exit changed. Registered in advance as expected-to-hold, and it held.

cost_finding.actual: 64. My registered estimate of 32 was wrong: sixteen rolls x crit/non-crit is 32, and the Substitute succeed/fail outcomes then produce distinct instruction lists that do not combine, doubling it again. Substitute is a staple move, so this is a materially larger search cost than the Flail/Reversal case the mechanism was built for.
cost_finding.consequence: The 2-way partition follow-up moves from optional to likely necessary. It is a second mechanism, so it needs its own registration -- but 64 arms on a common move is a different proposition from 64 arms on Flail. The search-side cost measurement, already owed for C27, now gates this too.

kpi.note: This one IS an engine change, so the delta is a genuine fidelity gain -- but it is measured on the C30 matcher, so it may only be compared against the C30 reading (99.662%), not against the pre-C29 readings taken on the old matcher.

certification_status.still_not_a_pass: A PASS is a property of the registered 10,000-game sweep under a registered contract, not of a 60-game diagnostic probe. C26's contract pins the 51-patch engine and the pre-C28 readout, so it cannot certify this build. A successor contract carrying C27-C31 plus the KPI must be registered, and the sweep run, before any PASS exists.
